cards.title: L1 activity
cards.method: Columns txns, active_accounts; weekly mean of daily values.
cards.sentence: L1 activity is down sharply from its peak: transactions average 663.84K/day over the last 30 days (-85% year on year, peak 8.30M/day around 2025-01-01), and active accounts 62.93K/day (-76% YoY).

cards.title: NEAR Intents volume vs price
cards.method: Daily volume (USD) as reported by DefiLlama's near-intents adapter.
cards.sentence: NEAR Intents settled $125.26M/day over the last 30 days (+58% YoY) and $32.91B in the last 365 days, while NEAR trades at $3.39.

cards.title: Fees and captured revenue
cards.method: L1: txn_fee_usd. Intents: gross fees vs NEAR's captured revenue (DefiLlama methodology: swept into revenue wallets, used for buybacks since 2026-02-23).
cards.sentence: Intents now out-earns the L1: NEAR's captured Intents revenue runs at $22.08M/yr (last 30 days annualized) against $1.16M of L1 gas fees in the last 365 days.

cards.title: Supply and inflation
cards.method: Trailing-365-day % change of total_supply; protocol max_inflation_rate from RPC.
cards.sentence: Supply grew 2.48% over the last 365 days, in line with the protocol's 2.5% max inflation; fee burn offset only 1.8% of issuance.

cards.title: DeFi TVL and stablecoins
cards.sentence: DeFi TVL on NEAR is $160.01M (+8% YoY) and stablecoins $132.01M (-22% YoY): capital parked on NEAR is small next to the volume flowing through Intents.

cards.title: Stake concentration
cards.method: Cumulative share of stake, validators sorted largest first.
cards.sentence: 44.4% of supply is staked across 342 validators; the largest 9 hold more than one third of stake (top 10: 36.3%).

cards.title: Developer activity
sources: GET https://api.github.com/repos/<repo>/stats/commit_activity for near/nearcore, near/near-sdk-rs, near/near-api-js, near/near-cli-rs, near/docs, near/intents, near/mpc, nearai/nearai
cards.method: Sum of weekly commits across tracked repositories (a sample of the ecosystem).
cards.sentence: The 6 tracked core repositories logged 569 commits in the last 12 weeks vs 473 in the 12 before.

cards.title: Hypothesis test: does Intents volume lead?
sources: metrics.lead_lag() on the joined daily table
cards.method: Pearson correlation of weekly log-changes at lags of -8..+8 weeks, Jan 2025 onward.
cards.sentence: The strongest weekly correlation between Intents volume changes and any target is r = +0.26 (txns, lag 0 weeks) against a noise band of ±0.20; for price the best is r = -0.14 at lag -3, so Intents volume does not reliably lead price.

cards.title: Valuation scenarios
cards.method: Discounted fundamentals-only value per token; edit the YAML and re-run.
cards.sentence: On cash flows alone the base case is worth $0.68 per NEAR today vs a $3.39 price; holding base assumptions, today's price implies Intents volume compounding 87% a year for 5 years.
